summary_rationale: Divi's Laboratories earns COMPOUNDER_PASS with PASS KPI health on a price-blind forensic audit. Over FY15–FY26, revenue scaled 3.39x (₹3,115 Cr to ₹10,560 Cr; ₹12,191 Cr TTM) and PAT scaled 3.01x (₹852 Cr to ₹2,568 Cr; ₹3,363 Cr TTM) with zero equity dilution, near-zero debt (₹6 Cr borrowings vs. ₹17,997 Cr equity as of Sep 2026), and 96.7% cumulative 12-year CFO-to-PAT conversion (106.6% in FY26). ROCE rebounded from its 16% FY24 post-COVID trough to 22% in FY26, while Custom Synthesis expanded to ~62% of H1 FY27 sales alongside Unit III Kakinada commercialization (Jan 2025) and 3,000-KL SPPS peptide line validation—driving Q2 FY27 OPM back to 43%. Key watchpoints are high strategic inventory (346 days), Custom Synthesis molecule lumpiness, and environmental/NGT permitting timelines.
